Led by high-quality hard-rock seismic, Fleet integrates geology, geophysics, drilling data, geochemistry and mineralogy with geoscience expertise and machine learning, turning complex subsurface data into actionable insight. You'll be the person Fleet Space looks to when we need to launch in a country we don't yet operate in, and the person who builds the planning rhythm, shared definitions and capacity forecasts that let us scale with rigour across the globe. This is a builder's seat, not a VP role with a large organisation underneath it. You'll lead a small team of two to four and work with line leaders of every department and you'll personally do much of the work rather than just design it. You'll start with training & onboarding on the ground in Australia, on the factory floor and out on a live survey in the field to understand our operations from end to end. Adelaide, South Australia is our Global HQ, so some early mornings and late evenings are common but you are also given a lot of autonomy and flexibility around where and when you work best. What you'll do Build and own our country entry playbook: customs clearance and temporary imports, local agent and partner selection, entity versus partner decisions, permits, visas, crew mobilisation and field HSE Know when a country needs a partner, when it needs an entity, and when we should walk away Work alongside our joint venture partners on delivery, without owning their commercials Connect manufacturing, supply chain, deployment and refurbishment as one system, connecting factory output to field demand so we are never building blind or short Own the Geode refurbishment loop: turn time, attrition, yield and the units that get stranded in country Set our spares, consumables and logistics strategy across regions, and manage supplier and contract manufacturer performance where it touches delivery Design and personally run the COO's operating & reporting cadence: annual, quarterly, monthly and weekly planning, with a clear owner for every input Create one shared definition of a survey, a deployment, a delay and a completion, and run operating reviews that surface the truth early rather than confirm it late Build the demand and capacity model for crews, Geodes, satellites, field engineers and geoscience interpretation, turning the commercial pipeline into headcount and hardware plans our leadership can plan against Track forecast against actual every quarter and keep making it better What we are looking for Chief of Staff or similar roles with a background in Operations, ideally within startup/scale up tech companies with a hardware component or mining/mineral exploration industry Strengths in Forecasting, Executive level reporting, GTM strategy development & building out various models, systems and frameworks Experience in companies with hardware products with responsibilities across manufacturing, supply chain, deployment, service or refurbishment A self starter, someone that can identify and prioritise the work rather than wait for a task to be given to them 8+ years in senior operations leadership positions, with recent experience executing & delivering projects yourself rather than only overseeing others but capable of people management as well A background in mining, mining services, geophysical survey, drilling, oilfield services or resources technology is a plus Experience across at least three of Latin America, the Middle East, Africa,
